name: Google Play
description: Google Play Billing and Real-time developer notifications for SaaS tenant plans.
long_description: The engine install is shared. Each project activates Google Play and stores its own package name and service account. Purchases start in the app. Verify and Real-time developer notifications settle the tenant ledger.

mutations.name: playInitialize
mutations.description: Google Play purchases start in the app

mutations.name: playVerify
mutations.description: Verify a Google Play purchase token

mutations.name: playWebhook
mutations.description: Handle a Google Play developer notification

mutations.name: playCancel
mutations.description: Cancel or revoke a Google Play subscription
